facts.fact: 假副手盘问 Garcia：两男一高矮、矮的留髭、高的光头戴毛线帽——Alex 对上 Andrews。
facts.anchor: The little guy had a mustache, the big one had sort of a shaved head

facts.fact: 尸检 headlines：体内有药、右颈动脉针眼。
facts.anchor: Needle mark in the neck here

facts.fact: 死时清醒——药效先退、溺死在后。
facts.anchor: but she was conscious when she died.

facts.fact: 倒立位开始吸水；气管损伤指向长时间咳嗽——几小时才死。
facts.anchor: Damage to the sinuses and the back of the throat suggested she was in an inverted position

facts.fact: 指甲被撕掉、指床嵌微粒、掌骨应力骨折（抠椅臂）——挣扎持续很久。
facts.anchor: We found particulate matter embedded in the nail beds, stress fractures in the metatarsals

facts.fact: 皮肤饱和度低——她被反复拉出又按入水中；不止一次。
facts.anchor: she was pulled out, and then lowered back in, and then pulled out, and then put in again.

facts.fact: 低剂量一小时失效——她醒着经历全部；胃里确认白葡萄酒。
facts.anchor: The drug was almost completely out of her system by time of death, though, which meant a low dosage

facts.fact: Alex 命令藏尸检结果、拖时间、别告诉验尸官——「只是拖住」。
Dana 问「我们站在谁那边」——Alex：「站在活人那边。」
facts.anchor: We’re on the side that keeps people alive.

facts.fact: Lacey 电话：丈夫们知道死法、组私刑 posse 拦人审人——「我失控了」；Alex 说「拦住他们」但没有答案。
facts.anchor: forming a fucking posse or whatever
